com.ibm.cos.v2.protocols.jsoncore.internal

Class NullJsonNode

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.protocols.jsoncore.internal.NullJsonNode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    JsonNode

    public final class NullJsonNode
extends Object
implements JsonNode
    A null JsonNode.

    Implementation notes: this class should've been outside internal package, but we can't fix it due to backwards compatibility reasons.
